questions.text: What mandatory structural precondition must a collection satisfy for binary search to function correctly?
options: The elements must be ordered according to a monotonic comparison relationship
The collection must be stored in a dynamically resizable hash table
All values in the collection must be unique positive integers
The collection must have an odd number of items to ensure a unique median
questions.correct_answer: The elements must be ordered according to a monotonic comparison relationship

questions.text: When the target element is strictly greater than the midpoint value, how are search boundaries updated?
options: Set low = mid + 1 to discard the lower half of the remaining interval
Set high = mid - 1 to restrict search to elements before the midpoint
Restart the search from index 0 using double the previous step size
Invert the array order and perform a linear scan backwards
questions.correct_answer: Set low = mid + 1 to discard the lower half of the remaining interval

questions.text: What condition signals that the target value is not present in the searched array?
options: The low pointer exceeds the high pointer, indicating an empty search interval
The midpoint calculation produces a floating-point index value
The algorithm encounters a duplicate element at the current midpoint
The array size reaches zero elements in physical system memory
questions.correct_answer: The low pointer exceeds the high pointer, indicating an empty search interval
